## Summary

[Partial] Locate and remove the EVAP tank's rear driver-side cover to document the valve version. [t291]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Locate the EVAP tank in the rear driver's corner.
2. Remove the plastic cover surrounding the tank.

## Tips & gotchas

- Document which version of the valve you have before removing it, as there are two versions available. [t291]
